posts.subject: Ban Apology for Olfy
posts.bodyHtml: Sorry for trolling and being nasty to mason alex and hypnoxas. I dont know what I was doing and I am sorry to hypnoxas and mason alex. Please forgive me. Also I shouldnt have called the admin on some players. Sorry

I don't think there should be a unban as I don't see you showing as much regret to what you have done also this is not your first ban so the other ones should give you time to rethink and see how bad you behaved also looking at the ban you got for "calladmin abuse and insults" ban is well worthy for me and should stay for the day so you get more time to rethink your behaviour and maybe read the rules.

Hey @Olfy


It's nice to see you apologizing for your behavior. The reason why you've been banned is quite obvious, as you were insulting several people on the server. Furthermore you used the !calladmin plugin although an admin was present at that time. I even told you not to use it, but you didnt listen. In my opinion apologizing is a big step in the right direction. But still, you did things wrong and I think this one day ban gives you some time to think about your behavior. Learn out of your own faults!
but but butttt noooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooo i LOVE DREAM SERVER TOO MUCH

As Hypnoxas said that your ban will not be lifted so you can think about your behaviour and I agree with him on this one as it's not your first ban you got for calladmin abuse or insult.
Ban is 100% reasonable and will not be lifted
you have been banned before so be quiet
@Olfy This Attitude won't get you anywhere.

@Olfy
Exactly this attitude has gotten you banned, being rude and insulting to other players. By writing this apology and then behaving the same way, it is safe to assume, that you have not learned anything from your ban. Hypnoxas has already decided to not unban you and now his decision is strengthened by your behaviour.


Please wait the appropriate time and try to be more polite and respectful to other users to not get a longer ban in the future.


[closesnew*]
